rationale: The agent properly authenticated the user via full name and zip, matched to a single account, and verified the order details. It confirmed the desired exchange item, presented available canister options, and the user chose the bagless version. Before making any changes, the agent summarized the exact exchange and refund method and obtained explicit confirmation. The exchange was executed using the correct order and item IDs, and the tool response shows the order moved to "exchange requested" with the correct price difference (-$9.89) and refund to the original PayPal method after explaining that no gift card exists on the account. All statements were supported by tool data, no writes occurred without confirmation, and the final information was accurate and aligned with policy for delivered orders and refunds.
